headlines.title: 3 Dividend Stocks Yielding Over 6% That Wall Street Loves
headlines.summary: Two income staples with big yields got cut from the list because analysts won't back them. The three that survived cover their payouts and still draw far more Buys than Holds, but one of them leans on casino rent.

headlines.title: Retire on Dividends: 5 Ultra-High-Yield Stocks Boomers Are Buying and Holding Forever
headlines.summary: A fat yield means little if the payout can't survive the next downturn. Five income stocks across tobacco, telecom, pipelines, and private credit each carry a hidden risk, and one even trimmed its distribution in half before.

headlines.title: $100,000 in These 5 Dividend Stocks Could Pay $4,800 a Year
headlines.summary: When the paycheck stops, price charts matter less than the cash landing in your account each quarter. Five high-yield names across pharma, utilities, tobacco, telecom, and midstream energy compete for that job, and one carries the thinnest safety cushion of all.

headlines.title: Can MO's Basic Brand Benefit From Growing Discount Cigarette Demand?
headlines.summary: Altria's Basic brand gains retail share as budget-conscious smokers shift to discount cigarettes amid growing consumer preference for lower-priced options.

headlines.title: Vanguard U.S. Momentum Factor ETF (VFMO) Adds Altria and ADP on Thursday
headlines.summary: The fund bought $13.6 million of Altria and $12.9 million of ADP while selling out of KLA and Corning.

description: Altria Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells smokeable and oral tobacco products in the United States. It offers cigarettes primarily under the Marlboro brand; large cigars and pipe tobacco under the Black & Mild brand; moist smokeless tobacco and oral tobacco products under the Copenhagen, Skoal, Red Seal, and Husky brands; oral nicotine pouches under the on! brand; and e-vapor products under the NJOY ACE brand. The company sells its products to distributors, as well as large retail organizations, such as chain stores. Altria Group, Inc. was founded in 1822 and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.
